subject: Privacy & logging controls — post-call recs and pilot next steps
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya@medlyhealth.com>
Cc: Anya Kowalski <anya.k@medlyhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: logging controls & redaction asks

Hi Priya / Anya — great meeting today, thank you for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our end (action owners in parentheses):

1) Scope of logs you need for the pilot
   - Request/response headers only for observability; bodies should be excluded unless explicitly permitted per endpoint (owner: Medly to confirm)
   - Retain sanitized request logs for 90 days (proposed) and aggregated metrics indefinitely (owner: Priya to confirm)

2) Sensitive fields to redact or hash
   - PII in headers (Authorization, Cookie, X-User-Email) — mask at collection point (owner: Redwood eng: Ben)
   - Trace IDs: hash or truncate so they can be used for debugging within a session but not tied to user IDs (owner: Redwood sec: Marissa)

3) Residency & compliance
   - Pilot in US region; if you need EU residency for PHI/workflows we can discuss dedicated deployment (owner: Mateo)

4) Evidence items you requested
   - SOC 2 scope summary, redaction playbook extract, and a sample sanitized log snippet (attachments: redaction_requirements_v1.pdf) (owner: Marissa)

Next steps:
- Marissa will produce a one-page remediation & redaction checklist and sample logs (ETA: 2027-10-05).
- Ben will scope engineering effort to implement header scrubbing and trace ID hashing for the pilot (ETA: 2027-10-07).
- Priya / Anya to confirm retention window and whether any endpoints require body capture for analytics.

If that matches your understanding, I can create a short pilot SOW and DocuSign link for signature.

Thanks — Mateo

--
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise Sales 
Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0198
From: Priya Rao <priya@medlyhealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Anya Kowalski <anya.k@medlyhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 09:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: logging controls & redaction asks

Thanks Mateo — that matches our notes. A few clarifications from Medly: 

- Retention: we need 90 days of sanitized request metadata (headers, routing info) for incident investigations. Beyond that, logs can be truncated to aggregated metrics.
- Bodies: we want NO request/response bodies captured by default. There are two endpoints where we may want bodies for analytics (consented debugging flows) — we'll list them and provide exact field-level allowlist by EOD 2027-10-06.
- Trace IDs: hashing sounds fine, but we need the ability to map a trace to a session within a 7-day window for root-cause analysis. If hashing is one-way, we need deterministic salt that we can agree on.
- Residency: US for the pilot. For PHI-handling workflows later we will evaluate EU options.

Attachments: I uploaded a short Medly data classification table separately; see Anya's link below.

Would you be able to share the sanitized sample logs in CSV/JSON form (no PII) so our security team can validate redaction?

Best — Priya
VP Product, Medly Health
priya@medlyhealth.com | +1-617-555-0145
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@medlyhealth.com>, Anya Kowalski <anya.k@medlyhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 06 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: logging controls & redaction asks

Looping in with the deliverables we committed to. See below for the checklist and timeline; I attached the redaction playbook excerpt.

Redaction & evidence checklist (deliverables):
- One-page redaction checklist (attached) — includes header allowlist/denylist and hashing recommendations. (attached: redaction_requirements_v1.pdf)
- Sample sanitized logs (JSON) — generated from an internal dev run with synthetic data, no PII. Will upload to Drive by 2027-10-05.
- SOC 2 scope summary — PDF excerpt included.

Engineering asks for Ben:
- Implement header scrubbing at the ingress layer; config-driven allowlist so Medly can toggle in pilot. (ETA initial PR: 2027-10-07)
- Add deterministic trace-hash function using team-shared salt stored in KMS; preserve a 7-day window via time-bucketed keys. We need to validate this approach with security. (ETA: prototype: 2027-10-11)

Security notes:
- We'll provide a short risk memo describing residual risk with hashed traces and mitigations (rotation schedule, limited key access).

Marissa — happy to coordinate the drive link. Mateo — should I prepare a short slide for the Medly security reviewers?

--
Marissa Cole
Security & Privacy
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya@medlyhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Anya Kowalski <anya.k@medlyhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 08 Oct 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot SOW & next sync (request/response logging pilot)

Hi Priya — attaching the pilot scope matrix (pilot_scope_matrix.xlsx) and a short SOW draft.

Summary of pilot scope based on our commitments:
- Region: US-only pilot
- Logs: headers and route metadata only; explicit deny on bodies unless allowlisted per endpoint list from Medly
- Retention: sanitized metadata retained for 90 days, aggregates retained longer
- Redaction: header-level scrubbing + deterministic trace hashing (7-day debug window)
- Evidence: sample sanitized logs + redaction playbook + SOC 2 scope excerpt (attached)

Action items for Medly before we kick off:
- Confirm endpoint allowlist for body capture by 2027-10-06 (Priya / Anya) — pending
- Sign SOW (DocuSign) so we can allocate the dedicated pilot slot (I will send the link once you confirm)

Internal action items (for clarity):
- Ben to open the header-scrub PR and include config flags for toggling allowlist (branch: feature/medly-redact).
- Marissa to upload sample logs and risk memo to the shared Drive folder and prepare 2-slide security summary for the Medly reviewers.

Can we schedule a 30-minute security sync next week (preferred windows: Tue/Wed 10/12–10/13) to walk the Medly team through the architecture and evidence? If that works I will send a calendar invite and the DocuSign link for the SOW.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this to a short pilot.

Regards,
Mateo Alvarez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
